dct_description_sm:
This project was carried out thanks to the financial support of component 2.2 of the MAMAH Regions and Rurality Fund (FRR).

The updates were made using orthophotos from spring 2020. The project covers the territory of the MRCs of Haut-Saint-Laurent, Haute-Yamaska, Haute-Yamaska, Roussillon, Rouville, Vaudreuil-Soulanges as well as the agglomeration of Longueuil.**This third party metadata element was translated using an automated translation tool (Amazon Translate).**
